people.gloss: A crane in the wild woods
people.role: A woodcutter's son with iron bones; the strongest loose cultivator of the pine sea, whom Tuần Tùng Đường wants for its Golden Core
people.appearance: Broad, sun-dark and bareheaded in all weathers, with a woodcutter's shoulders, his father's axe across his back, and the top of his left ear gone where a wolf caught it in 1190.
people.backstory: Lâm Dã Hạc was born in 1145 in Tùng Hạ Thị to a poor branch of the Lâm woodcarvers of Lộc Minh, and a crane landed on the roof the day he was born (A063). His father felled pines for the market, and the boy carried the axe at nine. At fourteen he walked up to the pines' outer gate on the word of his cousin Lâm Điêu Bách (lam_dieu_bach), long an inner disciple there. The examiner heard iron in his root and said what had once been said of the chain-smith Vưu Liên Hoàn (vuu_lien_hoan): the Listening Pine Primer would take him and grind against him all his life. Lâm would not sit the gate on those terms. He went home and traded a winter's firewood to a smith's widow for the Nine-Temper Scripture. In the wolf winter of 1190 (A064) he stood on the Tùng Hạ road beside Hứa Vãn Cung (hua_van_cung) for three nights. When the road wardens swore to the pines the next spring (V043), he would not swear. He formed his foundation at forty-one on a Yellow method and a pill from the jar behind Bì Tứ Nương's (bi_tu_nuong) counter. Every caravan master at the market says the hall's Golden Core will be him.
people.wants: A Golden Core on his own road, and then a Profound Metal method to carry him past the sixth layer of a Yellow one. He will not kneel to a sect for either.
people.secret: His foundation has a hairline crack from the cheap pill, and he knows a Kết Đan breakthrough on it may kill him. He has told no one, least of all Hứa Vãn Cung, who is waiting for him to try.

people.role: Boss of the frost coast's ruin-diggers, licensed by the Pavilion's Hall of Cold Law to dig the coast's dead halls
people.appearance: A small grey woman in a seal-fur coat patched from three coats, who carries an old bronze lamp lit even at noon and talks to it more than to her crew.
people.backstory: Phàn Cổ Đăng was born in 1010 in the fish lanes of Mộc Lan Thành, among the families who came from frozen Lẫm Đông Thành when the sea crushed its harbour (V079), and she learned to dig in that drowned city's ice before she learned to read. The frost coast is a coast of dead halls: Hàn Giang Môn (C099), burned Thoa Lạp Trấn (V077), Sóc Phương Thành emptied by the Pavilion (V078), Băng Hỏa Môn that split and burned itself out (V083), and Tầm Tung Viện, whose masters walked into Vô Tung Lâm and did not come back (V085). She has dug their outer halls and storerooms under the Hall of Cold Law's licence, which takes a tenth; the ice under Hàn Giang's own hall she leaves alone, because the Liên Giang fishers would not forgive her. In 1158 she dug the Track Seekers' empty academy, and in 1160 she sold its water-stained tracking manual from a stall in Tống Khách Thị. The hunter who bought it, Tiêu Vấn Phong (tieu_van_phong), built Tầm Kiếm Đường on it. In 1171 her Dao partner Thiệu Tàn Đăng (thieu_tan_dang) forced the fire hall of Băng Hỏa Môn with a borrowed fire talisman, and its ward burned him where he stood (N-loose_north-01). His bones are still inside. She has run the crew alone since, out of the market where the sword sage Tư Không Hạc Niên (tu_khong_hac_nien) sits and teaches no one. She is the only person there he plays go with.
people.wants: To bring Thiệu Tàn Đăng's bones out of the fire hall of Băng Hỏa Môn and stand him in the ice above Mộc Lan, facing the sea he dug beside.
people.secret: The fire hall opens only to fire qi. She did not take Dư Chúc Nhi into the crew out of pity: she means to send the girl through the door that killed Thiệu. She also knows that Hồng Lô Cốc on the cape would teach a Fire root properly, and she has not told her.

people.gloss: Heaven's gift (the old chief's joke: no one else gave the boy anything)
people.role: Chief of the robbers of Đoản Vĩ Cương, the Bobtail ridge; Triều Ngũ Lang's sworn brother from the camp
people.appearance: A long-armed old man in a lynx-skin cap with the bob tail left on, the camp's badge, and an axe hafted in lynx bone through his belt.
people.backstory: Khấu Thiên Tứ was a foundling of the robbers' camp on the Ridge of the Bobtails, raised beside another nobody's son, Triều Ngũ Lang (trieu_ngu_lang), by the old chief Tề Đoản Vĩ (te_doan_vi), who had two woodsmen's axes re-hafted in lynx bone for the two boys. In 1081 a Thúy Vi road patrol ran them down on the Thạch Công road. Khấu got away into the bracken. Triều did not, and a stranger's mist hid him (N-vu_an-02). Triều never came back, and Khấu has never forgiven the mist. When the old chief died under a patrol's swords in 1139 (N-loose_north-02), Khấu took the band. He is a Golden Core in a hill camp, the strongest thing on the cape's roads that answers to no sect. The band takes from carts that do not pay Vụ Ẩn Môn's road fee, carries grain to the charcoal and tea villages in bad winters, and is fed and hidden by them in return, as Ẩn Loan once fed its pirates (A025). In 1190 his lieutenant Dương Tam Đao (duong_tam_dao) fell on a caravan under the mist on the Đồng Sơn road, and Bối Trường Đình (boi_truong_dinh) died holding it (N-vu_an-04). Khấu let the raid stand rather than lose the band. Since 1190 Thúy Vi's road patrols have come onto the Đồng Sơn road and the ridge's lower crossings as if they knew where the band would be.
people.wants: To keep the ridge free of every sect for as long as he lives, and to sit across a fire from Triều once more before one of them dies.
people.secret: In the 1190 raid he saw Triều carry a six-year-old boy out of the mist and lowered his own axe to let them pass. The boy is Ký Thất Lộ, who has sworn to kill the band, and Khấu would let him try.

people.role: A Fire root born in an ice-cutters' village; the ruin crew's thaw-girl
people.appearance: A thin girl with chapped red hands that are always warm, frost-burn marks on her cheeks from the winter the village tried to cool her in the lake, and hair she cuts with a hot knife.
people.backstory: Dư Chúc Nhi was born in 1180 in Tạc Băng Thôn, where the families cut the winter sea ice for the lake towns' cellars, and her father's blocks sweated in her arms. By six she could melt a hole in the lake with her palm. In an ice-cutters' village that is a curse, and the village said so, and one winter tried to cool her in the lake. The pearl manor's gate at Hàm Nguyệt Trang asks for Water and the pines' outer gate for Wood or Water, and she had too little of either; both sent her home. In 1195 Phàn Cổ Đăng's (phan_co_dang) crew came to open the frozen doors of Bắc Minh Quán, the abbey its hermits left on the northern shore in 332 (V001), and hired the ice-cutters. Chúc Nhi melted a door the cutters could not chip. Phàn paid her father ten stones a year for her and bought her the Scorch Fist Primer at Tống Khách Thị. She has thawed eleven halls on the frost coast since, and she thinks Phàn is the kindest person she has ever met.
people.wants: A real Fire method and a teacher with fire in her, and enough stones sent home that Tạc Băng stops calling her a curse.
people.secret: She has twice gone alone to the sealed fire hall of Băng Hỏa Môn and felt its door warm under her hand, as if it knew her. She has not told Phàn, because Phàn's face changes whenever anyone says the hall's name.

people.role: Caravan guard for hire at Tùng Hạ Thị; taught the boy Hứa Vãn Cung the road
people.appearance: A tall woman of eighty-eight who looks fifty, with a bowyer's bow from her home village and a staff worn white at the grip.
people.backstory: A bowyer's daughter from Cung Tiễn Thôn, Thư Phiêu Bình has guarded caravans on the pine-sea roads for seventy years and sworn to no one. In 1164 she took on a fourteen-year-old magistrate's son who had failed the pines' chant, Hứa Vãn Cung (hua_van_cung), as her wagon boy, and Doanh Thủ Lộ (doanh_thu_lo) joined them later. The three rode as one company until a quarrel over pay in 1188. In the wolf winter (A064) she was on the southern road with a Pivot column. Hứa held the road without her, and Doanh died on it. She sends Doanh's son in the herb valley, Nghiêm Tục Đoạn (nghiem_tuc_doan), half of every fee.
people.wants: To be asked to guard a caravan that is not taking a road she has already seen.
people.secret: She has kept the pay of the last wolf-winter run in her boot since 1188, and Hứa Vãn Cung and Doanh Thủ Lộ each think the other drew it; she is waiting for one of them to ask.

people.role: Night ferryman of the Cold Ford river mouth, who carries anyone across and remembers no one
people.appearance: A stooped man in a reed rain-cape who poles without a lantern and has never been seen to hurry.
people.backstory: Nhâm Độ Hàn's family has poled boats across the Cold Ford river mouth since the fishers paid the pines' resin tax in fish (A041). His Water root would have taken him into Tùng Đào across the water, and his grandmother would have drowned him first; Thúy Vi, which took the coast back in 905 (C166), wanted Wood and Earth. So he ferries. He crosses at night, takes a fish or a stone, asks no name and keeps no face. His daughter Nhâm Liễu Ngạn (nham_lieu_ngan) went up to Thúy Vi and carries letters over his river; he poles her and does not ask whose they are.
people.wants: One night in a bed that does not rock, and for Cù Lô Nhi to take the dawn crossings without being told why.
people.secret: With every fare he scratches a tally on the keel board of the boat, and the board is nearly full; Cù Lô Nhi has seen it and has begun to read the marks.

people.appearance: A plump old woman with a pearl in each ear, one real and one glass, who never says which.
people.backstory: A pearl broker's daughter of Quy Điểu Trấn, where the market is held on the lake ice (A011), Cát Châu Nương came to Hàn Tân Thành in 1120 and opened a dice house on the quay. She keeps a ledger of every debt on the Cold Ford coast and remembers every loser; the one she likes best is a young Hồng Lô alchemist of 1144. In 1192 she bought the debts of a Phù Kiều gambler, Luyện Đắc Bảo (luyen_dac_bao), on Hồ's silver, and named the price to his sister.

people.backstory: Quản Tuyết Tung grew up in Liệp Hộ Thôn, the hunters' village, and hunted the northern forest beside the girl next door, Diêm Lạc Nhạn (diem_lac_nhan), until she went south. In the autumn of 1189 he and the old trapper Nhung Tử Điêu (nhung_tu_dieu) dug a wolf-king's cub out of its den in Quần Lang Lâm and sold it to a buyer riding south with a Pivot caravan. That winter the pack followed the caravans to Tùng Hạ (A064). He has never said so, and he bought his foundation pill with the money.

people.role: Guide to ruins in the northern markets; leaves his clients at the last turn
people.appearance: A smiling man in scholar's grey with ink on every finger and a map case on each shoulder, one for buyers and one he never opens; he stops to catch his breath on every stair, and his clients carry the cases the last stretch.
people.backstory: Giả Chỉ Lộ sells the walk, not the paper. He walks buyers to the ruins his maps name: the sword cave a Hòe Âm hunter found and lost (A108), the Peach Spring whose only true map Lạc Đan Thanh (lac_dan_thanh) keeps, Mặc Huyết Sinh's abode, Cung Hỏa Vân's vent. He takes half the fee at Tùng Hạ Thị or Lam Yên Thị, half at the foot of the climb, and leaves them at the last turn. He buys Hách Tùng's (hach_tung) honest copies of Tầm Kiếm's massif to learn the passes down. Lâm Dã Hạc (lam_da_hac) followed him up Ngọc Hồ Sơn, was left at the last turn, and came back with frostbite and a laugh. In 1197 a buyer he had left went on alone, came back and paid him double. Giả does not know what the man found.
people.wants: A map of one ruin he has actually climbed to the top of.
people.secret: This month he has sold the Peach Spring walk to three parties who all set out on the same morning, and Lạc Đan Thanh's man has found out.
